title: Halifax Party Cruise
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Subject to favorable weather conditions. If canceled due to poor weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund (primary concern is high winds)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Friday Night
Experience new country in Halifax while you dance with friends aboard the Harbour Queen I. Guests will spend two and a half hours cruising the waters of Halifax Harbour while enjoying music from DJ Cruise! Full cash bar onboard.

Saturday Night 
We’re taking the dance club to the water for the Halifax Party Cruise – perfect for a night out with friends, a bachelor or bachelorette, or to celebrate the best part of the week – the weekend. Join us Saturdays on the Harbour Queen for this two-hour party cruise on the Halifax Harbour. DJ Mutts will be playing all the party favourites, plus taking requests and our onboard bar will be stocked with refreshing beers, coolers, and spirits - don’t miss out!
